altText: Louise Mailloux and Sue Bernier of Woonsocket presented the St Jean Baptiste Educational Foundation $600 Catholic School grant to the Greater Woonsocket Catholic Regional School. The third grade students were very happy to be in the photo and all said “thank you”. In the photo is Jennifer DeOliveira, Principal. Your generosity helps us provide a strong Catholic education rooted in Gospel values, ensuring our children grow into compassionate, faith-filled leaders.

Here are two very grateful recipients of the $500 Foundation grant to St. Michael Elementary School (SMS) in Fall River, MA.Left to right: Father Jay Mello, SMS Spiritual Advisor, Alfred Dumoulin, Jr., Somerset Chapter N442 President, Louise Boulanger, Secretary/ Treasurer, and Ryan Klein, SMS Principal.

Photo of chapter #42 presenting a grant check to the President of Bishop Feehan High School.In the photo are our Chaplain Rev David Costa, Mr. Sullivan and #42 officers Paul and Sheila Pinsonnault.The check was presented at a 100th anniversary Mass for St Mary/Sacred Heart Elementary School. Our chapter has been a strong supporter of the school since it opened in 1923 and continue today. We made it a point to take the picture in front of the St Jean Baptiste statue. Our chapter members in 1904 petitioned Bishop Stang to build a French speaking parish. That was accomplished and the statue has been in the church since the building was finished.

photo from Cardinal Lacroix Academy, Manchester, NH, presented by CFL chapter NO91 Manchester, NH with students and left to right Diana Morin, Vice-president, chapter NO91, Principal Beverly Broomhall and Chapter NO91 Secretary/Treasurer Gloria Pilotte.

On September 19th, our chapter delivered the $500.00 check from Saint Jean Baptiste Educational Foundation to East Catholic High School in Manchester Ct.Mr. Sean P. Brennan, President, was very pleased to get this much-needed funds to help existing and future families with the goal of signing up for the best education.He was thrilled to share with us that since the start of the 2021-2022 school year, the freshman class enrollment is up 45%! He stated that this is a testament to their commitment to excellence in academics, athletics, and fine arts.

Dr. Coral May Grout, a member of Chapter 84 of greater Winchendon, presented a check to Colette Goguen, Principal of Holy Rosary Academy Middle School in Gardner, MA on September 12, 2023. The award was in the amount of $500 from the St. Jean Baptiste Educational Foundation through its New England Chapters Catholic School Scholarship/Grants program. Goguen was happy to announce that the funds will be used to support technology instruction.
Sue Griffiths handing the principal, Elise Macateer, the check as our pastor, Fr. Roy Parayil, looks on. The donation was given to St. James Catholic Elementary School in Danielson, CT
